limitations: Same local Docker Linux VM and synthetic 720p30 H.264 source. Small samples, no p95/p99 or target-hardware guarantee.
Producer HTTP endpoint is already ready; process boot, browser page navigation, Next.js authentication and credential issuance are excluded.
Fresh activations use separate producer processes. The cold source exercise recreates the encoder and adapter within one already running producer process.
Same-page reopen is immediate and stays inside the one-second qualification idle grace; the bundled deployment default is five seconds.
The adapter qualifier now explicitly sets the bundled 250ms track-gather timeout; previous adapter reference used the MediaMTX default.
GOP, frame rate, resolution and target bitrate are unchanged. An extra key frame is requested on reader arrival.
Steady-state CPU has four samples per 15-second baseline phase. This does not establish activation CPU peaks, physical capture latency or impaired-network performance.
Expected composition excludes physical scanout. Native MediaMTX pull has no adapter hook and is not an optimized-startup claim.
Cycle/cancellation pilots use private runners whose hashes are retained; integration into the portable qualification runner remains outstanding.
